_about: Agent test bench for Rathaa (22 Oct 2026). Each scenario runs through the real reply pipeline (app/services/agent_bench.py). 'classify' and 'reply' are the SCRIPTED model outputs used in CI (tests/test_agent_bench.py); scripts/agent_bench.py --live ignores them and calls the real router. 'expect' is graded in code. Placeholders: {d+N} = today + N days, {peak} / {peak+N} = the next 31 December (+N days; no published rate on purpose), {quote_total:<package>} = the price engine's total for this stay. World: Rathaa's catalogue published, two caravans (travel 6), Rathaa's sales playbook. setup.price_disclosure defaults to handoff.
